title: 3EN Agent full round-trip test
description: Verify the complete workflow: approved local execution, test validation, result.json creation, and automatic upload of the execution result back to GitHub.
backup: $Dir='C:\3EN-Agent\roundtrip'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Dir | Out-Null; $File=Join-Path $Dir 'roundtrip.txt'; if(Test-Path $File){ Copy-Item $File "$File.bak" -Force; Write-Host "Backup created: $File.bak" } else { Write-Host 'No previous roundtrip file.' }
script: $File='C:\3EN-Agent\roundtrip\roundtrip.txt'; @('3EN ROUNDTRIP PASS',"Generated=$(Get-Date -Format o)","Computer=$env:COMPUTERNAME") | Set-Content -Path $File -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Created $File"; Get-Content $File
test: $File='C:\3EN-Agent\roundtrip\roundtrip.txt'; if(-not(Test-Path $File)){throw 'Roundtrip file missing.'}; $c=Get-Content $File; if($c[0] -ne '3EN ROUNDTRIP PASS'){throw 'Unexpected roundtrip marker.'}; Write-Host 'ROUNDTRIP LOCAL TEST PASS'; Get-Content $File
rollback: $File='C:\3EN-Agent\roundtrip\roundtrip.txt'; $Bak="$File.bak"; if(Test-Path $Bak){Copy-Item $Bak $File -Force; Write-Host 'Previous roundtrip file restored.'}else{Remove-Item $File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Roundtrip file removed.'}
